purpose: Dallas final visual-identity and live-event concurrency QA: stress personalized chibi rendering across simultaneous role participants, authoritative revisions, viewport changes and asset failures while proving that identity, action eligibility, football ownership and verified signatures remain deterministic.

qualityContract.appearanceAuthority: current official headshot-derived appearance lock only; never infer visible appearance from player name
qualityContract.identityAuthority: DAL/roster.json player slug plus current uniform number
qualityContract.concurrencyRule: Each rendered participant retains its own roster identity and appearance lock; scene orchestration may not borrow another player's face, number, action state, anchor or personalized cache entry.
qualityContract.failureBoundary: Personalized rendering remains presentation-only; authoritative NFL Gamecast truth survives every QA failure and no MLB/NHL state is read as an identity fallback or mutated.

qaChecks.assert: Quarterback, receiver, blocker and defender can coexist in one bounded scene without player slug, official-headshot appearance, uniform number or personalized cache cross-contamination.
At every animation instant the football has at most one authoritative visual owner; pass, catch, interception, fumble and recovery transfers cannot duplicate the ball.
An authoritative correction arriving during tackle/contact immediately preempts obsolete motion and reconstructs from the newest accepted revision without residual collision state.
Resize/orientation changes reproject all participants from canonical scene coordinates while preserving relative scale, foot anchors and camera intent rather than accumulating transforms.
A personalized asset that finishes decoding after its event revision is obsolete is discarded and cannot flash into the current scene.
Failure of one participant's appearance/number/provenance gate suppresses only that personalized participant; remaining verified participants and authoritative event text continue normally.
Every personalized action chosen during concurrent playback is present in that exact player's DAL/roster.json action inventory; physical archetype supersets never expand runtime eligibility.
Only verified qualifying events may route named signatures: CeeDee Lamb nose-wipe on his authoritative first down and Von Miller DeSoto Shuffle on his authoritative sack.
A verified signature never steals football ownership, replaces higher-priority authoritative play motion, or blocks a newer accepted revision.
Representative overlapping chibis retain clean transparent alpha with no opaque matte, halo or rectangular canvas exposure under Gamecast compositing.

Given the same accepted event revision, roster snapshot and asset versions, cold start, warm cache and reconnect resolve identical player identities, eligible actions, ownership and signature eligibility.
All qa-07 execution remains inside NFL/Dallas presentation state and requires zero MLB/NHL file, route, cache or store mutation.

acceptanceFixtures.assert: QB-to-WR completion with blocker and defender resolves four distinct Dallas identities, legal actions, stable anchors and exactly one football transfer to the receiver.
Catch animation corrected to interception cancels receiver ownership and reconstructs the defender outcome without duplicate football or stale receiver recovery.
Correction during tackle contact clears obsolete collision/root motion before the corrected event settles.
Mid-play viewport resize preserves participant ordering, canonical scale relationships and foot anchors without drift.
Delayed asset decode from a superseded play revision is ignored and never flashes into the active scene.
One participant failing headshot provenance or number validation falls back locally without substituting another Dallas player's appearance.
A concurrent participant request for an action outside that player's roster inventory fails closed while other eligible participants continue.
CeeDee Lamb nose-wipe can run only after his accepted first-down event and is preemptible by a newer authoritative revision.
Von Miller DeSoto Shuffle can run only after his accepted sack and is preemptible by a newer authoritative revision.
Any named Dallas celebration outside the verified signature registry is rejected rather than inferred or invented.
Cold, warm and reconnect runs of the same fixture produce equivalent identity/action/football/signature semantics.
Executing every qa-07 fixture changes no MLB/NHL code or data and performs no cross-sport state writes.
